values.note: $10/night for a single site, $20 for the double sites (7 and 12); first-come, first-served season rate on recreation.gov.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351773/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-03 to 2026-11-30: WalkInSingleCampsite $10, WalkInDoubleCampsite $20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First-come, first-served only (recreation.gov lists only a 'First-come, First-served Season' walk-in rate and takes no reservations). A forest order restricts camping in the Cranberry and Williams River areas to designated sites; limit 2 vehicles per campsite.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351773 (not reservable; notices 'Limit 2 vehicles per campsite') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/cranberry-and-williams-river-camping-areas (Order 09-21-12-05: 'Restricts camping to designated sites and the number of vehicles at campsites in Cranberry and Williams River areas'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Fourteen separately numbered sites, 6-19, along a 5-mile stretch of Forest Road 76 between Big Rock and Cranberry campgrounds; 7 and 12 are double sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/cranberry-river-sites ('Fourteen primitive and separately numbered campsites dispersed along a 5-mile section of the lower Cranberry River ... Double sites available at sites 7 and 12'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One accessible vault toilet across from site 7 and one near sites 15-19 at Aldridge Branch; toilets close November 30. Each site has a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post; trash collection.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/cranberry-river-sites ('One accesible vault toilet across from site #7 and one near sites #15-19 at Aldridge Branch', 'Potable water is not available at this site', 'Toilets closed as of November 30') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351773 ('Each campsite has a picnic table, fire ring, and lantern post'; amenity 'Trash Collection'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Forest Service designated sites (Gauley Ranger District), not free dispersed camping: changed fees $0 -> $10 single / $20 double (rec.gov FCFS-season rate); booking FCFS only, not reservable (overrides the inherited rec.gov booking row); added 14 sites, no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water. Not stated: rig size, season (the rec.gov FCFS season Apr 3-Nov 30 is a rate season, not recorded). Note left as is.
flags: Fees: the recorded $0 rested on the forest's general dispersed-camping rule (wvdn.com), but these are numbered fee sites: recreation.gov's rate table charges $10 a night for a single site and $20 for a double ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-03 to 2026-11-30). This result replaces the $0.

Missing website: the Forest Service page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/cranberry-river-sites (also https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10351773, 'Cranberry River Campsites').
Missing phone: Gauley Ranger District, 304-846-2695 (recreation.gov facility phone and the FR 76 closure order).
Criteria: neither the Forest Service nor recreation.gov says what size rig fits the sites (no lengths in the RIDB catalog cache either).

Road caveat (not a closure of the sites): Forest Order 09-21-02-26-05 closes segments of FR 76 (Cranberry River Road) during construction, Sept 8 - Nov 20, 2026, section 1 from 38.2622,-80.5191 to 38.2862,-80.5323 (the southern approach from Richwood); the Forest Service says Cranberry and Big Rock campgrounds stay reachable from the north via FR 101 and CR 46/2 near Dyer.
